tools.page_desc: From video compression and audio extraction to AI upscalers — fully browser-based, ready to use.
tools.footer_desc: 9 tools · Browser-based & server-side · No data is stored.

xml_optimizer.title: 5MB XML Generator
xml_optimizer.subtitle: Alight Motion
xml_optimizer.desc: Process Alight Motion project files (.xml) to keep them under the 5MB limit — useful for sharing presets with free users.

project_converter.title: Project Converter
project_converter.subtitle: AE → AM
project_converter.desc: Convert beatmark data from Adobe After Effects to Alight Motion XML format. Seamlessly sync music from PC to Mobile.

audio_extractor.title: Audio Extractor
audio_extractor.subtitle: FFmpeg WASM
audio_extractor.desc: Extract audio tracks from any video file and export directly as MP3 — no server uploads, fully in-browser.

seq_renderer.title: Sequence Renderer
seq_renderer.subtitle: AM Zip Exporter
seq_renderer.desc: Combine image sequences from Alight Motion Export (.zip) into a single video. Add optional audio, set FPS and bitrate.

media_enhancer.title: Media Enhancer
media_enhancer.subtitle: AI Upscaler
media_enhancer.desc: Enhance video and image resolution using WebGL AI. Various presets available: Cartoonist, Human Detail, Smooth Face, and more.

upload_optimizer.title: Quality Method
upload_optimizer.subtitle: TikTok HQ Upload
upload_optimizer.desc: Compress & optimize videos for TikTok upload at the highest quality. No pixelation, no blur — ideal 1080p 60fps H.264 VBR format.

social_analytics.title: TikTok Statistics
social_analytics.subtitle: Metadata Analyser
social_analytics.desc: Full analysis of TikTok video metadata — resolution, duration, FPS, file size, and engagement stats. Just paste the URL.

video_compressor.title: Video Compressor
video_compressor.subtitle: FFmpeg WASM
video_compressor.desc: Reduce video file sizes directly in your browser using FFmpeg WASM. H.264 CRF 20 codec — perfect balance between small size and sharp quality.

motion_smoother.title: Motion Smoother
motion_smoother.subtitle: FPS Upscaler
motion_smoother.desc: Artificially increase video frames per second (FPS) — convert 24fps or 30fps videos to 60fps+ with frame interpolation.
